what.text: This page follows refugees from Syria living in Iraq.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 308226 Syrian refugees in Iraq, 6.3% of all Syrian refugees.
Türkiye, Germany, Lebanon and Jordan host more.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over the government of Syria from 2011 to 2025, with Syrian insurgents, at war level from 2011 to 2020 and in 2023 and 2024.
It also records armed conflict with the Islamic State group from 2013 to 2025, and over Rojava Kurdistan territory with the PYD from 2012 to 2015.

when.text: UNHCR's figure for Iraq rose from 2000 in 1985 to 308226 in 2025, its highest.
The main years of displacement in the data are 2013 to 2025, after big changes between 2011 and 2013.
Returns from Iraq to Syria were highest in 2025 in UNHCR's returns data.

how.text: These are year-end totals of refugees in Iraq only.
People displaced inside Syria are counted separately by UNHCR and by IDMC, and their figures are never added.
The sources don't say which routes people took or where in Iraq they live.
